title: TapList dataset
description: A festival dataset: top-level metadata plus a list of beers. Loaded after the catalog using the URL the catalog provides. See docs/data-model.md §2 for the prose spec.

id.description: Stable dataset identifier. Used as the localStorage namespace key for user data, so it MUST remain stable across versions of the same dataset (e.g., daily updates of the WBF 2026 list all share id: "wbf-2026"). Slug-safe: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens — no leading/trailing/double hyphens.

festival.description: Human-readable festival name. Shown in the UI header.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last dataset update. Powers the 'updated X ago' indicator. If absent, the app falls back to the fetch time.

beers.description: The list of beers. Beers missing required fields (id, name, brewery) are dropped at load time with a warning.

id.description: Stable across dataset versions. User data is keyed off this. The dataset author commits to never re-using or re-purposing an id.

abv.description: Percent alcohol by volume as a number (e.g., 5.2 — not "5.2%"). Optional; use null or omit when unknown. The runtime parser is lenient with stringly values like "6.5%" or "5-7" and treats them as missing, but they don't satisfy this schema.

description.description: Free-form long-form text. The brewery's own write-up, tasting notes, or backstory. No length cap.
